title: Chen Nian Appears
next_chapter_hook: After Chen Nian left, the riddles he left behind echoed like thunder—what secrets lie hidden in the Chen family's fate? And how will the Holy Sect's intervention stir this chaotic chessboard?

text.content: In the Mental Sea, the outline of the second page of the Tianji Record flickered indistinctly, its fragmented runes sparkling like stars yet always lacking that final stroke. Chen Ji sat cross-legged at the edge of the Forbidden Grounds, brow furrowed, fine beads of cold sweat on his temples—Mo Xiansheng's warning still echoed in his ears: 'The price of the second page might be your life.' However, just then, a familiar aura swooped in from afar, causing his pupils to constrict sharply.

That aura was too familiar—so familiar he almost thought it an illusion. The rainy night of separation seventeen years ago, his mother's cries, his little sister's wailing, and that desperate gaze as she was forcibly taken away—all carved into his very bones, never fading. Wind rolled up clouds of dust, several figures emerged from the mist, and the one in the lead wore a玄black long skirt, black hair cascading like a waterfall, her features still bearing traces of the old轮廓.

dialogue.content: 'Brother, I've returned.' The voice was gentle yet carried a tremor, 'Fifteen years—do you still remember me?'

text.content: Chen Ji rose slowly, his expression平静如水, only his fists hidden in his sleeves trembling slightly. His gaze swept across the experts behind Chen Nian—their auras深沉如渊, all at Nascent Soul realm or above, and faintly emanating an uncomfortable demonic path aura. His eyes flickered, his mind racing at lightning speed: why was the Tianji Record's foresight of her always so vague?

dialogue.content: 'I remember.' His voice was flat, betraying no joy or anger, 'I just didn't expect our reunion would be under such circumstances. When did the Chen family's castaway become the Holy Sect's honored guest?'

text.content: Chen Nian's steps faltered slightly, a wounded light flashing in her eyes, quickly replaced by a bitter smile. She raised her hand, and all the experts behind her retreated ten zhang. 'Brother, you truly still resent me.' She stepped forward slowly, each footfall striking Chen Ji's heartstrings, 'But there are things I must tell you myself—about the Holy Sect, about the Eye of Heavenly Dao, about... Father's final entrustment.'

dialogue.content: 'The relationship between the Holy Sect and the Eye of Heavenly Dao runs deeper than you imagine.' Chen Nian's voice lowered, 'Every generation of Seers—including the Tianji Record's holders—were merely pieces on that Eye's chessboard. Brother, you think you're setting the board, but from the very beginning, you've been watched.'

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze hardened, his heart掀起惊涛骇浪. The Eye of Heavenly Dao! Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned this name, yet his sister had revealed it with a single sentence. He suppressed his surging emotions, his face remaining unruffled. 'Pieces?' He laughed lightly, 'Then who sent you here today? The Eye of Heavenly Dao, or that one from the Holy Sect?'

Chen Nian ignored his questioning, slowly withdrawing an ancient jade pendant from her sleeve. The pendant was entirely jet black, its surface covered in densely packed ancient runes, faintly emanating an aura from the same source as the Tianji Record. 'This is Father's legacy.' She extended the jade pendant toward Chen Ji, 'He had me pass it to you before his death, along with these words—'Heavenly Secrets are not mechanisms; the one who breaks the game exists beyond Heavenly Secrets.'

The instant Chen Ji took the jade pendant, the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea shuddered violently—the fragmented second page actually revealed several clear runes, though they vanished in a flash, allowing him to glimpse some crucial information. His heart was shocked, yet his expression grew colder. 'The breaker of the game exists beyond Heavenly Secrets...' He repeated softly, his gaze sharp as a blade scrutinizing Chen Nian, 'Who truly sent you?'

dialogue.content: 'I am a person of the Chen family.' Chen Nian's eyes reddened, yet she stubbornly refused to let tears fall, 'Brother, I know you won't trust me easily. But some things I cannot explain here. You only need to know—the Holy Sect's interior is not a monolith, and I am also a piece, just with a different chess path.'

text.content: A cold snort echoed from afar, and a black-robed elder behind Chen Nian stepped forward, his thick demonic pressure bearing down like a collapsing mountain. 'Saint Maiden, time is running short.' The elder's voice was hoarse, his eyes flashing with impatience and arrogance, 'This boy is merely trash—why waste breath on him?'

choice.prompt: Facing the Holy Sect expert's arrogance and his sister's dual pressure, Chen Ji must make a choice—probe the truth or retreat to advance?

choices.text: Examine the Jade Pendant on the Spot
choices.description: Immediately activate the Tianji Record to examine the jade pendant's origins, risking exposure to obtain the truth
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information: the jade pendant's origin and Father's truth
choices.risk_hint: May expose the Tianji Record's abilities, alerting the Holy Sect experts

text.content: Chen Ji held the jade pendant in his palm, his brow center faintly glowing—the Tianji Record quietly circulated, the runes on the fragmented page moving like living things. He saw a blurry image: Father Chen Xuan, on his deathbed, handing this jade pendant to a shadowy figure while whispering something. That shadow turned its head—赫然是 Ling Yuan!

dialogue.content: 'Interesting.' Chen Ji withdrew his divine sense, a meaningful smile curving his lips, 'It seems Father left不止这一枚棋子 more than one piece on the board.' He looked at Chen Nian, his gaze gaining a complex edge, 'This jade pendant, I'll keep.'

choices.text: Coldly Mock and Strike Back at the Black-Robed Elder
choices.description: Ignore the provocation, dismantle their momentum with words, maintaining his废物人设 while hiding his edge
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the Holy Sect arrivals, rescuing his sister from a difficult position

text.content: Chen Ji didn't even lift his eyelids, his voice lazy yet clear entering everyone's ears: 'Trash? A堂堂化神后期堂堂 expert like yourself can't even discern my true strength—can you really afford to call me trash?'

dialogue.content: 'Moreover, with the Saint Maiden present, what right does a servant like you have to comment?' He raised his eyes, cold light flickering in his depths, 'Is this how the Holy Sect teaches its disciples respect?'

choices.description: Directly question his sister about choosing the Holy Sect, observing her reaction to judge truth from falsehood
choices.visible_reward: Obtain information on Chen Nian's true stance

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze fell on Chen Nian, his tone flat yet carrying unavoidable pressure: 'Fifteen years apart, yet you've become the Holy Sect's Saint Maiden. How do you expect me to believe you're not here to scout for them?' He paused, 'Or is this too Father's arrangement?'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's form trembled slightly, yet she quickly steadied her expression. 'Father never arranged my path.' Her voice grew hoarse, 'It was his words before his death that showed me my own way. Brother, I am not a piece—I intend to be the Chess Player.'

text.content: The black-robed elder's face turned ashen with fury, about to erupt, when Chen Nian raised her hand to stop him. 'Enough.' She looked at Chen Ji, tears glistening in her eyes yet forcibly suppressed, 'Brother, I must go. At the Holy Sect... I still need time to set my pieces.' She withdrew a token from her bosom, gently placing it on the ground, 'If you ever need me, shatter this token.'

Chen Nian turned to leave, then suddenly stopped. She didn't look back, yet her voice clearly reached Chen Ji's ears: 'The Chen family's fate extends beyond the Heavenly Dao's chessboard.' Her figure gradually faded into the mist, leaving only her final words, 'Father also said... the Tianji Record's true secret lies on the third page.'

Chen Ji stood in place, his gaze deep and profound as an abyss. The direction Chen Nian departed was precisely into the Forbidden Grounds' depths—where something was sealed, beyond even the Tianji Record's complete foresight. He lowered his head to the jet black jade pendant in his hand and the ancient token on the ground, his thoughts churning like a tide. 'The third page...' He murmured, a decisive light flashing in his eyes, 'It seems this game is larger than I imagined.'

In the Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded faintly: 'She speaks truth. The third page... indeed exists.' Chen Ji's eyes flickered, about to press further, but Mo Xiansheng fell silent once more. No matter how he called, the remnant soul guardian gave no response, as if it had never existed. Chen Ji gripped the jade pendant tightly, his knuckles white. Ling Yuan, Chen Nian, the Eye of Heavenly Dao... all clues pointed in the same direction—the Tianji Record's true origins were far more terrifying than he had imagined.

choice.prompt: After Chen Nian left, Chen Ji faced the tangled mysteries alone. Should he pursue into the Forbidden Grounds to seek truth, or first organize the clues he already possessed?

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, his form flickering as he vanished into the mist. The Forbidden Grounds' atmosphere was cold and uncanny, every step like treading on knife points. However, just as he pursued into the depths, a familiar aura suddenly appeared—Su Qingyao! She was being attacked by several black shadows, covered in wounds, yet still clutching a glimmering jade slip in her arms with desperate strength.

choices.visible_reward: Deduce part of the truth Father left behind

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, placing the jade pendant and token side by side before him. He closed his eyes and urged the Tianji Record, and both relics simultaneously glowed faintly—a blurry image emerged in his Mental Sea: Father Chen Xuan confronting a blurry figure, and in that figure's hand was赫然 another eye identical to his own!

text.content: Chen Ji's form flickered,整个人如鬼魅般融入暗影. He followed Chen Nian's group from afar, watching them stop before a concealed cliff. Chen Nian walked alone into the cliff face—hidden there was a secret door! Through the crack, he vaguely saw Chen Nian kneeling before a enormous eye totem, whispering something.

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, as night fell, he still stood at the entrance to the Forbidden Grounds, gazing at those幽深莫测的迷雾. The jade pendant in his hand faintly radiated heat, as if responding to his bloodline. 'The Chen family's fate extends beyond the Heavenly Dao's chessboard...' He softly repeated his sister's parting words, complex light flickering in his eyes. What had Father seen that rainy night fifteen years ago? What existence was the Eye of Heavenly Dao that Chen Nian spoke of? And what earth-shaking secrets were hidden in that sealed third page?

Just then, the Tianji Record's fragmented page suddenly shuddered violently! Chen Ji looked down to see the previously blurry second page outline had become clearer, several ancient characters emerging at its edge—'Heavenly Fate can be defied; the Chess Player cannot escape.' His pupils constricted sharply—this was the first time the Tianji Record proactively displayed such an explicit warning. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his Mental Sea, but only uttered one sentence: 'She can be trusted, but within the Holy Sect... it's more chaotic than you imagine.' Before the words faded, a thunderous roar echoed from afar, and golden light shot skyward from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds!

Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly—the golden light's direction was precisely where Chen Nian had disappeared. He gripped his fists, his heart torn between heaven and man—pursue or not? If Chen Nian spoke truth, the Forbidden Grounds' depths likely held clues to the Tianji Record's third page; but if it was a trap... He took a deep breath, a decisive light flickering in his gaze. Chen Nian was his sister, his only blood relative remaining in this world. Whether the path ahead led to dragon's pool or tiger's den, he had to make this journey. 'Little sister...' He murmured, 'This game, Brother will play it through with you.'

The instant Chen Ji stepped into the mist, the Tianji Record's fragmented page burst forth dazzling golden light, illuminating his path. He saw the concealed door in the cliff face, and also that familiar back before it—Chen Nian stood there, as if she had been waiting all along. 'Brother, I knew you would come.' She turned, tears glistening in her eyes, 'I've waited fifteen years for this day.' From the mist, more figures emerged—Holy Sect experts, Forbidden Grounds guards, and an existence that shook Chen Ji's very soul: Ling Yuan! That aged face bore a诡异的笑容, stepping toward Chen Ji inch by inch. 'Chen family's boy, we meet again.'
